title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.
